name: にちか
text:
さっむ……
────さ、寒いですね、美琴さん……！
trans:
It's freeezinggg...!
―I-It's so cold isn't it, Mikoto-san...?!

name: 美琴
text: うん、そうだね
trans: Yep, it really is.

name: 美琴
text: 練習中暑かったから、余計に
trans:
It was warm and cozy during practice,
so it feels much colder than normal.

name: にちか
text:
……で、ですよね……！
寒暖差ありすぎです
trans:
...I-I know, right...?!
The difference between
temperatures is just too much...

name: 美琴
text:
もっと厚手のコートで
来ればよかったかな
trans:
We should've probably
worn thicker coats.

name: にちか
text:
ほんとに……
ここまで冷え込むって、思わなくて……
trans:
True, really...
I just didn't expect that it'd get this chilly...

name: 美琴
text: ……うん
trans: ...Yep.

name: にちか
text:
今日に限ってプロデューサーさん
用事あって送れないとか言うし
trans:
And out of all days, it just so happens
that Producer-san can't pick us up
because of other commitments...

name: にちか
text:
風邪引いたりしたら
どうするんだって──……
trans:
What on earth is he gonna do if we end up
catching a col―

name: にちか
trans: Ah...

name: にちか
trans: It's snowing......!

name: 美琴
trans:
......
...it really is......

name: にちか
text: わぁ……！
trans: Woaaaah...!!

name: にちか
text:
……すごい
明日には積もりますかねー……！
trans:
...Wooow!!
I wonder if it'll pile up on the streets tomorrow...!

name: 美琴
text: ……どうかな
trans: ...I wonder.

name: にちか
text:
あ……っ、じゃないじゃない。積もったら大変ですよね
電車とか止まるかもだし……
trans:
Ahh...! Actually no, scratch that! It's gonna be
a lot of trouble if it piles up, won't it?! Like trains
and other stuff might stop...

name: にちか
text: 不便なことばっかりで……
trans: It's just going to be a ton of hassle if so...

name: 美琴
text:
……そうだね
明日、撮影もあったし
trans:
...Right.
We also have a photoshoot tomorrow, so...

name: 美琴
text:
積もったりしたら、プロデューサーも
迎えに来れないかもしれないね
trans:
If snow piles up tomorrow, then Producer might
not be able to come and pick us up again.

name: にちか
text: で、ですね……
trans: T-True......

name: にちか
text:
……あっ、でも美琴さんは
あんまり珍しくないかもですよね……！
trans:
...Oh, but, I guess this isn't that
rare for you, right, Mikoto-san...?!

name: にちか
text: 雪って
trans: The snow, I mean...

name: にちか
text:
すみません、私
雪くらいでなんか……はしゃぐみたいな
trans:
Sorry, it's just... I got way too
excited over just a little snow...

name: 美琴
text: ああ……
trans: Ohh...

name: 美琴
text:
ううん
そんなことないよ
trans: Nope, not in the slightest.

name: 美琴
text:
たくさん積もるような雪は
私もしばらく見ていない気がするから
trans:
In fact, I think it's been a long time
since I've seen enough snow to pile up.

name: 美琴
text:
あまり地元には
帰っていなかったし
trans:
I don't fly back to my hometown
that often in the first place.

name: 美琴
text:
それに……雪を珍しく感じるくらいには
時間が経ったってことかな
trans:
And besides... The fact that snow has become
a rare sight for me shows how much time has
gone by, I guess.

name: 美琴
text: こっちに来てから
trans: Time since I've started living here, I mean.

name: 美琴
text:
行こう
あっちの通りでタクシー拾えそう
trans:
Let's get moving.
Looks like we could hail a cab over on that street.

name: にちか
text: ……あの、美琴さん
trans: ...Uhm, Mikoto-san!

name: にちか
text:
どのくらい積もるか
わからないですけど
trans:
I don't really know how
much snow will pile up, but...

name: にちか
text:
もしも積もったら、私
雪だるまとか作っちゃおうかなって
trans:
If it actually ends up piling a lot, then...
I was thinking of... making a snowman,
or something...

name: にちか
text: 思ってたりして……
trans: Just a silly thought......

name: 美琴
text: ……そうなんだ
trans: ...Oh, really.

name: 美琴
text:
じゃあやっぱり
厚手のコートじゃないとね
trans:
We really should wear
thicker coats, then.

name: 美琴
text:
作るなら……撮影の前かな
一度、事務所に寄るだろうから
trans:
If we're gonna make them, then... We should make
it before the shoot, I guess. Because we might
drop by the office first, anyway.

name: にちか
text:
は、はい……！
そうですね、事務所で……！
trans:
G-Got it...! That's true...
We should make it near the office...!

name: 美琴
text:
手袋もした方がよさそう
……あったかな
trans:
It'd probably be good to put on some gloves too.
...Wonder if I still have mine around.

name: にちか
text: わ、私あります……！
trans: I-I have some spare ones...!

name: にちか
text:
防水のスプレーかけて
持ってきます……！
trans:
I'll put some waterproofing spray
and bring them tomorrow...!

name: 美琴
text:
……そっか
ありがとう
trans:
...Alright.
Thank you.

name: 美琴
text: ……積もるかな
trans: ...I wonder if it'll pile up.
